item.title: Tools built for LLMs, not for humans
item.description: We hand models tools that were designed for people: general purpose languages, Unix, containers. What would we build instead if the model were the user? A language that is safe by construction, a runtime that reports a limit rather than killing you, and preludes the model writes itself.
